texts: So, I only joined about two months ago.
And my first visit was, um, quite overwhelming, honestly.
I walked in and nobody really, like, said hello or showed me around.
I didn't know where anything was or who to ask.
I stood there for maybe ten minutes before somebody noticed me.
I think a proper welcome for new people would help a lot.
Even something simple, like a checklist, or a buddy for your first week.
And the tools, a lot of them don't have any instructions next to them.
I was scared of breaking something, so I just didn't touch half the machines.
Um, what else. I guess it could just be, you know, better in general.
I'm not sure how to say it exactly.
But once I knew a few people it got much better, so it's really the start that's rough.
